releaseNotes:
FFS 1.0.0 — Internal test build

• Reliable Android back navigation (tabs return to Home)
• Clearer Home, Reports, and transaction list layout
• Default account types & categories on first launch
• Transfers excluded from spending reports
• Improved goals progress and contribution screens
• Demo bank notification can be simulated repeatedly
• Local-first finance: transactions, reports, goals, OCR, CSV export

This is an internal testing release. Data stays on your device.
